name: Reveal Design Backyards
lede: A Chicago landscape design-build firm specifies Bromic into its pergola work. In Glenview, electric heaters hang from an opening louvered pergola; in North Center, a city backyard pergola is equipped with heaters too.
data: Bromic electric heaters – model to confirm

photos.caption: Glenview. Photo: Reveal Design, via revealdesignchicago.com. Permission to publish to be confirmed.

beats: In Glenview, a suburban backyard brings together a composite deck, an opening louvered pergola, an outdoor kitchen, a fire table and privacy planting. In North Center, a city backyard pairs a pergola with a garage party door and a deck.
In a cold city, both backyards were designed for long outdoor seasons, with heat built into the structure.
In Glenview, Bromic electric heaters hang from the aluminum pergola. For North Center, the firm’s listing names Bromic heaters and the project page says the pergola is equipped with heaters.
